Every nonadjacent pair of supporting facets yields a distinct zero radius; their number equals the degree bound, so the center value fixes every factor. Positivity and strict radial decrease follow from the factor signs. A direct sine-product gives vertex denominator and global ratio. A Riemann-sum argument yields the limiting circle spectrum. Independent direct finite verification: 2556 standard-library checks, n=3..35; high-precision supplemental 1164 checks, n=3..29. No finite test is claimed as the infinite proof.
